mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.id AS role_id, p.id AS permission_id, COALESCE(rp.data_scope, r.data_scope) AS data_scope, (rp.data_scope IS NOT NULL) AS overridden, p.data_permission FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.perms = #{permissionCode}

SELECT r.id AS role_id, p.id AS permission_id, COALESCE(rp.data_scope, r.data_scope) AS data_scope, (rp.data_scope IS NOT NULL) AS overridden, p.data_permission FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_code = 'superadmin' )
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'superadmin' AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.role_code = 'superadmin' AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0
